name: usage-bar
description: Над полем ввода три бара в строку: заполненность контекстного окна, расход пятичасового лимита подписки за сессию и недельный лимит. Под ними строка кеша промпта: сколько прочитано из кеша и сколько до его истечения, /cache открывает таблицу по ходам. Цвета и кеш настраиваются в /config

color.title: UsageBar: Color
color.description: Fill of all bars and their main percent figures. Default: the terminal's gray; Claude: orange; the rest are the 16 Windows cmd colors (color /?)

sessionColor.title: UsageBar: Session color
sessionColor.description: This session's share of the session and week bars and their +N% figures; same palette as UsageBar: Color

cacheRow.title: UsageBar: Cache row
cacheRow.description: Show the prompt-cache row under the bars, styled like them: share of the prompt read from the cache, tokens read, written and sent uncached, the countdown to expiry and, when the cache is not warm, what to do about it

cacheTtl.title: UsageBar: Cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the cache lives after a request: auto follows Claude Code's own rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, the promptCacheTtl setting, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1 hour on a Claude subscription and 5 minutes on an API key, cloud provider or usage credits) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

cacheWarnSeconds.title: UsageBar: Cache warning (s)
cacheWarnSeconds.description: Seconds left on the countdown at which it turns the session color and a toast reminds you the cache is about to lapse

cacheCompactAtTokens.title: UsageBar: Cache large context (tokens)
cacheCompactAtTokens.description: From this prompt size up, an expired cache suggests /compact (or /clear) before you pay to write the whole prefix again

cacheToast.title: UsageBar: Cache toasts
cacheToast.description: Toasts as the cache lapses: at the warning threshold, then at 10, 3, 2 and 1 seconds, once per cache entry each (only for prompts of 20k tokens or more)

cacheStatus.title: UsageBar: Cache in status line
cacheStatus.description: Also pin a short entry (hit rate and countdown) under the prompt
